scope: Four-direction navigation accepted; user-reported bottom black-square artifacts remain an open rendering defect

navigation_scope: Four directions only; no confirmation/game launch or special-button integration
open_visual_defect: User reports small black squares at bottom when frame changes; cause not proven
kernel_patch: Embedded PID1 only; reversible image hash verified. Same input-enabled kernel and matching DRM module as hardware input capture.
map_scope: Only measured UP712->bit4 RIGHT715->bit5 DOWN713->bit6 LEFT714->bit7. Derived from human-labelled physical capture and canonical calibration; verified against actual console frogui/keymap.txt.
publisher_policy: Compile-time R36_KEYS_NAVIGATION_ONLY refuses maps other than four unique direction bits4..7; confirm/game-launch and special buttons not mapped
lifecycle: Publisher exclusively creates SysV segment, restores held state, emits ready marker. PID1 starts UI only after ready; stops UI if publisher lost; kills/reaps publisher before report-only SD RW remount. Default non-navigation neutral segment unchanged.
storage_policy: SD RO while child processes run; settings RAM bind-copy/menu_sounds=off; no stock init or action daemon. RAM reports copied only after child/publisher stop.
raw_keys_report: r36-ui-keys.txt collected to unique trial .ui-keys.txt; previous diagnostic report cleared before trial
